_: The loading screen's toy taxi and its layout (Q209), the user's pick of a small super-deformed
cab idling over a taxi meter. ONE drawing, two readers: tools/make_splash.py draws the still
frame into boot_splash.png (the boot splash and the iOS launch screen), and
scripts/ui/loading_cover.gd draws it live over the menu's first seconds, so the cover takes
over from the splash without a jump. Change a number here and re-run the tool.
Units: a stage stage_px high that fills the screen's height; x right, y down, from the screen's
centre. A body shape is in the body's own frame, origin ride_px above the ground and pitched
by the idle; the wheels, the ground and the exhaust stay on the ground. Colours are sRGB hex.
The line's text is menu_text.json's loading row, both languages; the meter's colours are
HudStyle's meter_lit / meter_unlit and the field is HudStyle.plate_field.
